title: skills/objectstack-data: lookupAutofill copies a currency amount only when both sides share the currency (after #36249)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

`Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by the #36249 PR (cross-currency price copy). Parent: #36249.

## What will be incomplete
`skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (the `lookupAutofill` paragraph, about line 97) says a lookup copies the declared source fields into the targets. Once #36249 lands, a copy of a `currency` source into a `currency` target whose currency differs from the source record's (a home-currency product price into a foreign-currency invoice line) no longer happens: the target is left empty and the form states why. An agent reading the skill would still promise the copy, and would not know to give the line a price in its own currency.

## Done when
The `lookupAutofill` paragraph says, in one or two sentences, that a currency-to-currency copy is made only when both sides resolve to the same currency (fixed or per-record), and that otherwise the target stays empty with a stated reason and is never converted. The grid-column `autofill` sentence says the same where it applies. The skill's evals still pass.

Blocked-by: #36249 (the behaviour must be on `main` first)

## Grade
p3 · area:data · domain:skills. A skill reader may model a price copy that the platform now declines; no data is wrong.
